e32778aabf46474b5528d93fd31da1f5.overview: Following an unexpected tragedy, child psychologist Malcolm Crowe meets a nine year old boy named Cole Sear, who is hiding a dark secret.
e32778aabf46474b5528d93fd31da1f5.tagline: Not every gift is a blessing.

e3507785e4f628f0ba6dfef5566cb6f4.overview: Llewelyn Moss stumbles upon dead bodies, $2 million and a hoard of heroin in a Texas desert, but methodical killer Anton Chigurh comes looking for it, with local sheriff Ed Tom Bell hot on his trail. The roles of prey and predator blur as the violent pursuit of money and justice collide.

e35170268ed11cc49acb9490e7b38fcc.overview: A runaway heiress makes a deal with the rogue reporter trailing her but the mismatched pair end up stuck with each other when their bus leaves them behind.
e35170268ed11cc49acb9490e7b38fcc.tagline: An unforgettable entertainment...the outstanding performance of two outstanding careers!

e364a706f1f9af3c254be3c5cfd2607b.overview: Inmates fight, pair off, try suicide and attempt escape at a British reform school for girls.
e364a706f1f9af3c254be3c5cfd2607b.tagline: IT'S A CRIME WHAT PRISON CAN DO TO A GIRL!

e3d388d5beb7a4f9986e84804b5b63b3.overview: Doctor Hugo Hackenbush, Tony, and Stuffy try and save Judy's sanitarium by winning a big race with a finicky horse owned by Judy's boyfriend Gil. There are a few problems. Hackenbush, who was recently put in charge of the sanitarium, isn't really a doctor, he's a veterinarian.
e3d388d5beb7a4f9986e84804b5b63b3.tagline: Three Great Laff Stars ! . . . more gags and gals . . . more songs and dances !

e3f114716fe3910cc5864e5cdc94fef1.overview: When an innovative modern architect flees post-war Europe, he is given the opportunity to rebuild his legacy. Set during the dawn of the modern United States (in Pennsylvania), his wife joins him, and their lives are forever changed by a demanding, wealthy patron.

e3fbb194df99612044fa33c6bfcfd69d.overview: David Sumner, a mild-mannered academic from the United States, marries Amy, an Englishwoman. In order to escape a hectic stateside lifestyle, David and his wife relocate to the small town in rural Cornwall where Amy was raised. There, David is ostracized by the brutish men of the village, including Amy's old flame, Charlie. Eventually the taunts escalate.
e3fbb194df99612044fa33c6bfcfd69d.tagline: In the Face of Every Coward Burns a Straw Dog.

e3fef9d2b7c1c60c644d391c008ffd0c.overview: The Private Life of Samuel Pepys is a 2003 British comedy television film directed by Oliver Parker and starring Steve Coogan, Lou Doillon and Nathaniel Parker.  It portrayed the historical diarist Samuel Pepys. It was aired on BBC2 on 16 December 2003, drawing an audience of 2.9 million viewers.
